ARABIC LANGUAGE — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does the Arabic word مَا اسْمُكَ؟ (maa ismuka?) mean? (1 mark)
   A. What is your name? (to a boy)
   B. and upon you peace (the reply)
   C. hello
   D. good evening

2. What does the Arabic word السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ (as-salaamu ʿalaykum) mean? (1 mark)
   A. good morning (the reply)
   B. I
   C. How are you? (to a boy)
   D. peace be upon you

3. How is the Arabic word أَنَا read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. sabaahu l-khayr
   B. maʿa s-salaama
   C. as-salaamu ʿalaykum
   D. anaa

4. The nuclear family is made of (1 mark)
   A. parents and their children
   B. neighbours
   C. grandparents and cousins
   D. uncles and aunts only

5. What does the Arabic word قِفْ (qif) mean? (1 mark)
   A. stand up
   B. touch your nose
   C. write
   D. close your eyes

6. Which day begins the week in the Arabic list? (1 mark)
   A. al-ahad
   B. al-khamiis
   C. al-jumuʿa
   D. as-sabt

7. How is the Arabic word غَدًا read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. madrasa
   B. yawm
   C. ghadan
   D. usbuuʿ

8. What does the Arabic word لَا (laa) mean? (1 mark)
   A. cake
   B. no
   C. song
   D. your turn

9. Which Arabic sentence means "I eat bread." (1 mark)
   A. أُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ
   B. أُحِبُّ الْعَصِيرَ
   C. آكُلُ الْخُبْزَ
   D. أَشْرَبُ الْمَاءَ

10. How is the Arabic word سَمَاءٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. matar
   B. ghaa'im
   C. samaa'
   D. mumtir

11. How do you read the syllable نِي? (1 mark)
   A. ni
   B. ba
   C. nii
   D. thaa

12. What does the mark sukuun (a small circle) show? (1 mark)
   A. The letter has no vowel
   B. The vowel is long
   C. The letter is silent and not written
   D. The letter is doubled

13. What is the special sign hamza (ء)? (1 mark)
   A. A dot below
   B. A short stop in the throat
   C. A kind of number
   D. A long vowel

14. How is the Arabic word ابْنٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. ʿamma
   B. jadd
   C. khaal
   D. ibn

15. How is the Arabic word جَدَّةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. jadd
   B. akh
   C. jadda
   D. ukht

16. How do you read the syllable مُ? (1 mark)
   A. mu
   B. na
   C. nu
   D. tu

17. Which Arabic word means "garden"? (1 mark)
   A. سَاعَةٌ
   B. حَقِيبَةٌ
   C. بَيْتٌ
   D. حَدِيقَةٌ

18. What does the Arabic sentence الْعَصِيرُ بَارِدٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The fish is delicious.
   B. The juice is cold.
   C. Water is useful (good for you).
   D. I like food.

19. How is the Arabic word طَمَاطِمُ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. tamaatim
   B. faakiha
   C. samak
   D. shaay

20. How is the Arabic word لِسَانٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. fam
   B. batn
   C. lisaan
   D. raqaba

21. What does maa ajmala l-bii'a mean? (1 mark)
   A. How beautiful the environment is!
   B. The rain is heavy.
   C. Where is the environment?
   D. I plant a tree.

22. What does the Arabic sentence الشَّمْسُ فِي السَّمَاءِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. How beautiful the environment is!
   B. The sun is in the sky.
   C. In the room there is a bed.
   D. And the rain is from the sky.

23. Which of these is a position word? (1 mark)
   A. ʿinda
   B. sariir
   C. kitaab
   D. qalam

24. What is the name of the Arabic letter ه? (1 mark)
   A. Saad
   B. dhaal
   C. raa
   D. haa

25. What is the difference between ح (Haa) and خ (khaa)? (1 mark)
   A. They are the same letter
   B. khaa has a dot above and Haa has none
   C. khaa has a dot below
   D. Haa has a dot above and khaa has none

26. What does the Arabic word نَافِذَةٌ (naafidha) mean? (1 mark)
   A. door
   B. bathroom
   C. window
   D. knife

27. Which letter is missing in الجم_ة? (1 mark)
   A. ع (ʿayn)
   B. ح (Haa)
   C. ف (faa)
   D. غ (ghayn)

28. Which Arabic word means "cake"? (1 mark)
   A. كَعْكَةٌ
   B. عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ
   C. أُغْنِيَةٌ
   D. رَقْصٌ

29. What does the Arabic sentence أَغْسِلُ وَجْهِي mean? (1 mark)
   A. My hand is small.
   B. I clean my teeth.
   C. I wash my face.
   D. My head is big.

30. Which Arabic sentence means "The wind is strong." (1 mark)
   A. الرِّيحُ قَوِيَّةٌ
   B. هَذَا مَطَرٌ
   C. هَذِهِ شَمْسٌ
   D. الشَّمْسُ حَارَّةٌ

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Translate into English: ashummu bi-anfii (2 marks)

32. Translate into English: ismii Ahmad (2 marks)

33. Explain why neat and legible writing matters when a poem is displayed. (3 marks) (3 marks)

34. Give three qualities of neat and legible writing. (3 marks) (3 marks)

35. Translate into English: haadhaa abii (2 marks)

36. List four characteristics of good handwriting. (4 marks) (4 marks)

37. Translate into English: jismii qawiyy (2 marks)

38. Read the sentence اسْمِي أَحْمَدُ and write its meaning. (2 marks) (2 marks)

39. Explain why it is important to know the days of the week. (2 marks) (2 marks)

40. Write a short conversation of three lines in which one friend asks about a party and the other answers. Use English letters. (3 marks) (3 marks)

41. Give two reasons why reading is important. (2 marks) (2 marks)

42. Translate into English: raʾsii kabiir (2 marks)

43. Translate into English: fii l-matbakhi taawila wa kursii (2 marks)

44. Rearrange the words to make a sentence and translate it: الْخَمِيسِ / يَوْمُ / الْيَوْمُ. (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Translate into English: akhii Sagiir (2 marks)

46. Translate into English: ash-shamsu haarra (2 marks)

47. Translate into English: ʿalaa t-taawilati kaʿka (2 marks)

48. Write the Arabic sounds and meanings of four position words. (4 marks) (4 marks)

49. Read these sentences and give the day for each activity: (a) adhhabu ilaa l-madrasa yawma l-ithnayn (b) alʿabu yawma s-sabt (c) aqraʾu kitaaban yawma l-ahad. (3 marks) (3 marks)

50. Write the Arabic sounds for 'two hands' and 'two legs' and give the meaning of each ending. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — MOCK EXAM #14 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — What is your name? (to a boy)
   مَا اسْمُكَ؟ (maa ismuka?) means What is your name? (to a boy).

2. D — peace be upon you
   السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ (as-salaamu ʿalaykum) means peace be upon you.

3. D — anaa
   أَنَا is read anaa and means I.

4. A — parents and their children
   The nuclear family is the smallest family group: parents and their children.

5. A — stand up
   قِفْ (qif) means stand up.

6. A — al-ahad
   The Arabic week begins with al-ahad, Sunday.

7. C — ghadan
   غَدًا is read ghadan and means tomorrow.

8. B — no
   لَا (laa) means no.

9. C — آكُلُ الْخُبْزَ
   آكُلُ الْخُبْزَ (aakulu l-khubza) means: I eat bread.

10. C — samaa'
   سَمَاءٌ is read samaa' and means sky.

11. C — nii
   نِي is read nii.

12. A — The letter has no vowel
   A sukuun shows that the consonant is read without a vowel.

13. B — A short stop in the throat
   The hamza is a short pause made in the throat, like the stop in 'uh-oh'.

14. D — ibn
   ابْنٌ is read ibn and means son.

15. C — jadda
   جَدَّةٌ is read jadda and means grandmother.

16. A — mu
   مُ is read mu.

17. D — حَدِيقَةٌ
   حَدِيقَةٌ (hadiiqa) means garden.

18. B — The juice is cold.
   الْعَصِيرُ بَارِدٌ (al-ʿasiiru baarid) means: The juice is cold.

19. A — tamaatim
   طَمَاطِمُ is read tamaatim and means tomatoes.

20. C — lisaan
   لِسَانٌ is read lisaan and means tongue.

21. A — How beautiful the environment is!
   maa ajmala is a cry of wonder meaning 'how beautiful'.

22. B — The sun is in the sky.
   الشَّمْسُ فِي السَّمَاءِ (ash-shamsu fii s-samaa'i) means: The sun is in the sky.

23. A — ʿinda
   ʿinda means at. The other words are things.

24. D — haa
   The letter ه is called haa.

25. B — khaa has a dot above and Haa has none
   khaa is Haa with one dot above.

26. C — window
   نَافِذَةٌ (naafidha) means window.

27. A — ع (ʿayn)
   The word is الجمعة, al-jumuʿa, Friday.

28. A — كَعْكَةٌ
   كَعْكَةٌ (kaʿka) means cake.

29. C — I wash my face.
   أَغْسِلُ وَجْهِي (aghsilu wajhii) means: I wash my face.

30. A — الرِّيحُ قَوِيَّةٌ
   الرِّيحُ قَوِيَّةٌ (ar-riihu qawiyya) means: The wind is strong.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: I smell with my nose.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: My name is Ahmad.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: Readers can read it easily, the dots and marks show the right words, and neat work shows care and pride.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: Letters of the correct shape and same size; letters on the baseline; correct dots and marks; small spaces between words.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid quality.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is my father.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

36. (4 marks)
   Answer: Correct letter shapes; letters the same size; letters on the baseline; correct dots and marks; even spacing; clean page.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid characteristic, up to 4.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: My body is strong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

38. (2 marks)
   Answer: ismii Ahmad. My name is Ahmad.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for reading and 1 mark for meaning.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: Days help us to plan what to do and to use time well, for example school, homework and rest.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for planning and 1 mark for good use of time.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: A: hal ʿindaka hafla? B: naʿam, ʿindii hafla. A: mabruuk!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the question, 1 mark for the answer and 1 mark for a suitable closing wish.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: It helps us to learn new words and information, and it gives us enjoyment.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible reason.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: My head is big.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: In the kitchen there is a table and a chair.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ. Today is Thursday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the first word, 1 mark for the correct order and 1 mark for the translation.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: My brother is small.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: The sun is hot.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: On the table there is a cake.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

48. (4 marks)
   Answer: fii (in), ʿalaa (on), taHta (under), fawqa (above).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: (a) Monday (b) Saturday (c) Sunday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct match.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: yadaani (two hands) and rijlaani (two legs). The ending -aani means two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word and 1 mark for the ending.
